course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice adding useful detail with som when talking about a recommendation.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Fika small talk about a film or series a colleague recommended.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Describing a thing or person clearly enough for the listener to understand the reference.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk during fika about a series or film that one of them recommended earlier.

main_focus.name: relative clauses with som
main_focus.description: Use som to add a short defining detail after a noun.
model_examples: Jag såg filmen som du rekommenderade.
Det är en serie som många pratar om.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use a relative clause with som naturally 2-3 times in the dialogue.

useful_chunks: Jag såg filmen som du tipsade om.
Jag hann bara se ett avsnitt.
Det låter som något för mig.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use most active words if they fit naturally, but keep the exchange casual and believable.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker mentions having watched something that was recommended earlier.
dialogue_shape.middle: They describe what kind of film or series it was and give a simple opinion.
dialogue_shape.ending: They agree on a next viewing plan or another recommendation.

target_complexity.repetition: some natural repetition of som is useful

focus: which recommendation seems interesting and why

sentence_focus: one sentence with som describing a film
one sentence with a simple opinion using tyckte
one sentence about watching only part of something
one sentence asking for a recommendation
one sentence combining a recommendation and a reason
